title: MCP termal_read_mailbox is listed but a call fails with TypeError "... is not a function" while the CLI read works for the same identity
outcome: MCP termal_read_mailbox is listed but a call fails with TypeError "... is not a function" while the CLI read works for the same identity
acceptance: The failing path is identified with file:line (the bridge's tool registration or dispatch versus the runtime's tool table), and the condition that leaves a tool listed but not callable is named.
A regression shows that a mailbox tool the bridge lists is callable, or that it is not listed at all; it never fails with a TypeError at call time.
When a mailbox tool is unavailable, the session receives a typed, actionable error naming the CLI fallback (TERMAL_CLI mailbox read), not a JavaScript TypeError.
